hooks.command: bun -e "let s='';process.stdin.on('data',d=>s+=d).on('end',()=>{const c=(JSON.parse(s||'{}').tool_input||{}).command||'';if(c.includes('release.sh'))console.log(JSON.stringify({hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:'PreToolUse',permissionDecision:'deny',permissionDecisionReason:'scripts/release.sh pushes to origin main and publishes to Docker Hub. Releases are run by the user, not by Claude.'}}))})"

f=$(bun -e "let s='';process.stdin.on('data',d=>s+=d).on('end',()=>{const t=JSON.parse(s||'{}').tool_input||{};process.stdout.write(t.file_path||'')})"); case "$f" in *.ts) out=$(bunx tsc --noEmit 2>&1) || { printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2; exit 2; } ;; esac
